summary: PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering (University of Oklahoma, 2025), with undergraduate teaching in Computer Programming, Communication Systems and Wireless Communication. Research in AI/ML for wireless networks, robust propagation prediction, digital twins, generative learning, domain adaptation and network self-healing. Experience in communications laboratory instruction, Bachelor’s/Master’s research-project mentoring and industrial engineering at AT&T Labs, Futurewei and AT&T. Well positioned for undergraduate ECE teaching, laboratories, capstone mentoring and applied research.

skills.Wireless Networks & Signals: LTE/4G, 5G-NR, RAN, mobility, RF propagation, signal analysis, network measurements, service assurance, outage management, optimization and digital twins

dissertationFocus: Doctoral research on reliable AI/ML for wireless networks, with propagation learning, synthetic-data augmentation, data-driven optimization and network resilience under real-world variation.
